comment: The xFD CV sumRange is a sweep position, not a voltage: knob plus CV is clamped to 0-1, which is 0% to 100%. Polyphony is consumed rather than passed on — the outputs are always single-channel, and with the PLY knob above 1 the sweep runs across the channels of the IN1 cable instead of across the four input rows. The signal jacks carry whatever is patched, so they get no family.
